texts.bulletin: DANGER — Extreme rainfall recorded in Basco, Batanes (107.5 mm/24h). Suspend ALL field operations. Avoid crossing rivers and flood-prone areas. Secure harvested produce in elevated dry storage. Activate DRRM protocols. Coordinate with MDRRMC, SWDO, and MAO for rapid damage assessment. Pre-position emergency seed buffer and postharvest equipment.
texts.sms: DA ALERT: Extreme rain in Basco. Suspend all farm work. Secure produce. Contact MAO for assistance.
texts.lgu:
AGRICULTURAL EMERGENCY ADVISORY — Basco
Extreme rainfall (107.5 mm/24h) requires immediate action:
1. Advise farmers to suspend all field operations immediately.
2. Coordinate with MDRRMC for damage assessment teams.
3. Pre-position tarpaulins and drying facilities.
4. Activate emergency seed replacement protocols.
5. Document affected crop areas for PCIC crop insurance filing.

🌾 Secure harvested crops from rain
🚫 Avoid rivers and flood areas
📞 Contact your Municipal Agriculturist for assistance

#DARFOCagayanValley #AgriculturalAdvisory #TayoNaHanda
